# Greennest Hub

> Greennest Hub (https://www.greennesthub.com.ng) is Nigeria and Africa's
> agricultural platform — farming knowledge, free farmer tools, market
> prices, weather, and a community where farmers ask questions and share
> strange experiences from their farms. Founded by Igono Joel (B.Sc.
> Agricultural Economics & Extension, Kogi State University).

## What the site covers

- Crops: practical guides for growing maize, cassava, yam, rice and other
  Nigerian and African crops — planting, care, pests and diseases, harvest
  and storage.
- Livestock: raising poultry, goats, cattle, pigs and fish — feeding,
  housing, health, breeding and income.
- Farm Business & Sales: how to sell farm produce well — pricing, buyers,
  markets, cooperatives, packaging and transport.
- Student Research Hub: final-year project topics, research guides and data
  for agriculture students.
- Safe Crops: which crops and plants are safe and which can harm people or
  animals, and how to handle them safely.
- Learn Farming: step-by-step guides and modern methods — irrigation,
  organic and climate-smart farming, soil care.
- News & Innovation: agriculture news, new methods, technology and
  government programmes for African farmers.
- Animals: wild animals, domestic animals, and animals and humans working
  together.

## Free farmer tools

- Fertilizer Calculator (/tools/fertilizer-calculator)
- Planting Calendar (/tools/planting-calendar)
- Profit Calculator (/tools/profit-calculator)
- Feed Calculator (/tools/feed-calculator)
- Market Prices (/tools/market-prices) — weekly food prices across Nigerian
  regions plus Kenya and Ghana, from published surveys only, never guessed
- Farm Weather (/tools/weather) — 5-day forecasts for Nigerian cities
- Unit Converter (/tools/unit-converter)

## Community

- Farmers' questions & strange experiences (/community) — ask a question at
  /community/ask; every question is reviewed before it appears.

## All articles

- Every article, newest first: /blog, with filters per
  section (for example /blog?category=crops).
